subject.title: feat(channels): add typed cross-surface approval actions

question: Should an authorized approval.resolve request with the wrong explicit owner kind terminally deny the canonical pending approval, or reject without mutation?
rationale: Both choices fail closed, but they differ materially in whether a stale, malformed, or misbound callback may consume a valid pending approval; repository policy cannot choose that permanent security and operator-experience contract.

options.title: Reject without mutation
options.body: Return an invalid or not-found response for the mismatched owner kind while leaving the canonical approval pending for a correctly bound reviewer.

options.title: Keep terminal deny
options.body: Treat any authorized wrong-kind verdict as malformed input that consumes the approval with a durable denial.

recommendation.title: Reject without mutation
recommendation.body: Return an invalid or not-found response for the mismatched owner kind while leaving the canonical approval pending for a correctly bound reviewer.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the durable approval design, canonical resolver, and exact-head tests defining the current mismatch behavior.
